feather-chat-timed-out-banner: Notice banner when the user is timed out. $1 is the formatted expiration date/time.
feather-chat-banned-banner: Notice banner when the user is banned from the contest chat.
feather-chat-deleted-msg: Placeholder shown for a deleted message. $1 is the deletion reason.
feather-chat-mod-action-delete: Action menu item to delete a chat message.
feather-chat-mod-action-warn: Action menu item to issue a warning to a user.
feather-chat-mod-action-timeout: Action menu item to temporarily mute a user.
feather-chat-mod-action-ban: Action menu item to ban a user from the chat.
feather-chat-mod-action-unban: Action button to unban a user or lift a timeout.
feather-chat-mod-drawer-title: Drawer or modal title for the chat moderation management interface.
feather-chat-mod-reason-placeholder: Input placeholder for providing a moderation justification reason.
feather-chat-mod-history-title: Section title for audit log of moderation actions taken.
feather-chat-mod-history-empty: Empty state text when no moderation actions have occurred.
feather-chat-mod-automod-alert: Security banner notifying the user that auto-moderation blocked an offensive message.
feather-chat-rules-hint: Community guidelines reminder shown above the chat input.
